source.check: All fourteen divisions read on the page image of the Returning Officer's 'Notice of result of elections, 1964' (Newry Reporter, 11 June 1964, p. 6).

note: Triennial election of Newry No. 1 (County Down) Rural District Council, fourteen single-member divisions. There was no poll: the Returning Officer's notice (P. J. O'Hagan, dated 8 June 1964) lists ten candidates elected without a poll and four retiring councillors deemed re-elected. Filed on 4 June 1964, the Co. Down county and rural polling day that year. No nomination; the notice lists him in column 7, 'Names of retiring Councillors deemed to be re-elected'. Division printed 'Carrickcrossan'. Deemed re-elected (no nomination).
